Your holdings:

Watch:

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, losing positions; margin amplifies every move.
plays: SOXL / SPAL: Re-evaluate and adjust stops for these "SELL" status leveraged ETFs immediately to protect capital. Their current stops are above market price, which is not a protective stop.
